description: Notebook only calls one-page fixture; recent success-rate kill switch is absent and collect_month is not notebook-orchestrated.
evidence: fixture networkCalls=0; coverage release says 58/79 unverified
impact: Production coverage can silently remain incomplete.
recommendedFix: Add a production-only source-policy gate and orchestrate tested collect_month pagination/checkpointing.

description: AGENT2_VALIDATOR quality status becomes PASS whenever executed=true, including status=EXECUTION_FAILED.
evidence: Master child result: AttributeError while gate construction selects PASS
impact: Cross-agent validation failure can be mislabeled.
recommendedFix: Require status=EXECUTED and crawlReleaseReady/fullCorpusAcceptance; otherwise FAIL or NOT_EVALUATED.

description: Master NOTEBOOKS executes A2-08/09 before required A4-00..04 producers.
evidence: registry upstreamStages conflicts with NOTEBOOKS tuple order
impact: Run can pass by consuming stale pre-existing Agent4 artifacts.
recommendedFix: Topologically sort stages and bind each consumer to current-run artifact hashes.

description: Master collects 27 child stage manifests for 23 executed children and does not enforce unique stageId/current-run ownership.
evidence: 27 manifest files, 23 unique child stage IDs, 108 termination files
impact: Duplicated/stale manifests can satisfy coarse counts.
recommendedFix: Require exactly one manifest per planned stage and verify runId, parameterSha256, sourceSha256 and artifact root.

description: crawl detail parser lacks unambiguous standalone ActivityText:* fallback implemented in pipeline parser.
impact: Older SSR shapes may lose body text.
recommendedFix: Port tested standalone fallback or call the shared pipeline parser.

description: Master audits filesystem existence/content but not tracked state; runtime gitHead was detached 71edc while crawl tree was untracked in that checkout.
evidence: current checkout reports ?? DSJA/project_4/crawl; source bytes match other branch blobs
impact: gitHead does not identify the executed source bundle.
recommendedFix: Record per-notebook blob SHA/ref and require clean tracked sources before bundle PASS.

description: Recovery writes fresh updatedAt timestamps into all frontier rows; repeated runs change CSV and Parquet content hashes.
evidence: two observed runs differ across 137 updatedAt values
impact: Content SHA is not stable for equal logical inputs.
recommendedFix: Exclude runtime timestamps from canonical frontier content or derive them from source lineage.

description: nbclient, BeautifulSoup and other execution dependencies are installed but not declared in the root project; papermill is documented but missing.
evidence: runtime matrix UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY and REQUIRED_MISSING rows
impact: Fresh environment reproduction is not guaranteed.
recommendedFix: Declare crawl notebook extras and lock versions; install papermill or remove its contract claim.

description: Executed Master output stores absolute repoRoot; live raw data is reached through an absolute symlink.
evidence: executed output contains repoRoot; crawl/data/raw symlink resolves outside checkout
impact: Artifacts are less portable and contract path policy is weakened.
recommendedFix: Display repository-relative root and configure raw root via validated runtime-only setting.

description: Thumbnail/logo candidates are labeled sourceField=files and fetched asset manifest is empty.
evidence: 59 candidates, 30 OCR, 0 asset rows; detail.py uses constant sourceField
impact: Asset lineage field is inaccurate and collection completeness is untested.
recommendedFix: Preserve actual source field and keep readiness NOT_EVALUATED until asset policy decision.

description: Live dirty workspace pipeline suite has 4 failures, while clean Agent5 base has 80/80 passing.
evidence: live 94 pass/4 fail; clean base 80 pass
impact: Results depend on checkout state and missing handoffs.
recommendedFix: Run release gates from a clean integrated worktree and publish its exact test inventory.

description: remaining_months.csv has one summary row rather than the 58 month identities.
impact: Human review cannot inspect the concrete resume plan.
recommendedFix: Export the actual periodMonth frontier when production coverage manifest is available.
